title: Directed Columbia citation flows by primary field
description: One row per ordered citing/cited OpenAlex primary field pair; count of distinct directed in-snapshot work pairs. Missing field is Unclassified.
code: SELECT coalesce(ta.field_id,'unknown') source_id, coalesce(ta.field,'Unclassified') source, coalesce(tb.field_id,'unknown') target_id, coalesce(tb.field,'Unclassified') target, count(DISTINCT (c.citing_work_id,c.cited_work_id)) AS n FROM citations c JOIN works a ON a.work_id=c.citing_work_id JOIN works b ON b.work_id=c.cited_work_id LEFT JOIN topics ta ON ta.topic_id=a.primary_topic_id LEFT JOIN topics tb ON tb.topic_id=b.primary_topic_id WHERE c.cited_in_snapshot GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC, source_id, target_id
